origin.description: The source file (a reference) or the decision that produced this table (C04 R[0]); a table without it is code

description.description: What the table checks, in the pack language

tier.description: Tier of the outcomes (C05 R[1]); default blocking when a basis is given, else advisory. Blocking needs a basis

basis.description: The acceptance contract clause a blocking check relies on (C05 R[1])

item.description: Pointer to the item identity in the subject (or in each node); copied into outcomes

location.description: Pointer to the reference URI of the item in the judged source; becomes a ground of the outcomes

text.description: Pointer to the quoted text inside a quotation

reference.description: Pointer to the reference URI the quotation cites

title: quote@1
description: Quotation table: every quotation must be an exact contiguous substring of the decoded fragment its reference resolves to. Case, punctuation, character width, Unicode normalization form and every whitespace character stay significant; no folding, trimming or normalization is applied. Empty and whitespace-only quotations never match. A mismatch refutes with QUOTE_MISMATCH
